findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract, find_specialist_for_task, route, resolve_link, parse_pdf, summarize · Private data: rerank, route, request_specialist, memory_context, remember, recall, forget, resolve_link, summarize, rag_search, try_bay_run · Public sink: route · Destructive: eval_models, embed, find_specialist_for_task, route, speed_test, request_specialist, remember, forget, calculate, resolve_link, try_bay_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract, find_specialist_for_task, route, resolve_link, parse_pdf, summarize · Private data: rerank, route, request_specialist, memory_context, remember, recall, forget, resolve_link, summarize, rag_search, try_bay_run · Public sink: route · Destructive: eval_models, embed, find_specialist_for_task, route, speed_test, request_specialist, remember, forget, calculate, resolve_link, try_bay_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
